escena: SCENE (journey mapping session, a working production studio in a converted Miami warehouse, golden hour): low raking golden sunlight comes through a tall industrial steel-framed window and falls ON BOTH PEOPLE, edging their shoulders and throwing long shadows across the pale brick wall behind them; the man and the woman stand side by side leaning over a wide pale oak worktable covered with a long sequence of printed cards that map a gelato brand's customer journey, and she is lifting one card out of the row and setting it two places earlier at the exact moment of the decision while he keeps his finger on the gap it leaves, mid-sentence. He is wearing a faded olive linen shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow; she is wearing a fine sand-coloured cotton knit; no jackets, no blazers, no navy or blue clothing on either of them. Both look down at the cards, never at the camera. A small orange adhesive tab marks the card in her hand. Around them the real tools of the studio sit in soft focus: a camera body on a folded tripod, a roll of seamless paper on end, a stack of printed proofs. No city skyline, no glass tower, no corporate boardroom. 16mm wide lens with the camera resting right on the near edge of the table, low. Everything is unbranded, no brand names, no readable text anywhere.

lecho.objeto: the near edge of the pale oak worktable right against the lens
lecho.tono: VERY LIGHT, bleached pale oak lit directly by daylight, almost white
